part_A.question: Mr. Smith gets up at 7 o’clock and eats ….
part_A.explanation: "eat a big breakfast" = ăn sáng thật no.

part_A.question: Mr. Winsor is from … . He’s English.
part_A.explanation: Người Anh ("English") thì đến từ nước Anh ("England").

part_A.question: My father / goes / three times / a month. / fishing /
part_A.answer: My father goes fishing three times a month.
part_A.explanation: Cấu trúc tần suất: S + V(s) + số lần + a month.

part_A.question: a beautiful / There is / house. / river / near my /
part_A.answer: There is a beautiful river near my house.
part_A.explanation: "There is + danh từ số ít + near + nơi chốn."

part_A.question: Ha Long Bay / two weeks ago. / Maria and / her family / went to /
part_A.answer: Maria and her family went to Ha Long Bay two weeks ago.
part_A.explanation: "ago" dùng với thì quá khứ: went … two weeks ago.

part_A.question: born / Her grandpa / was / on 12th / February 1952. /
part_A.answer: Her grandpa was born on 12th February 1952.
part_A.explanation: "be born on + ngày tháng năm": was born on 12th February 1952.

part_A.question: in spring? / What does / your mother / often / do /
part_A.answer: What does your mother often do in spring?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi: What + does + S + often do + in + mùa?

part_A.question: are not / of Lan’s house. / to the left / There / many trees /
part_A.answer: There are not many trees to the left of Lan’s house.
part_A.explanation: Câu phủ định "There are not many + danh từ số nhiều + to the left of…"

part_A.question: How many / are there / your class? / in / pupils /
part_A.answer: How many pupils are there in your class?
part_A.explanation: Hỏi số lượng: How many + danh từ số nhiều + are there + nơi chốn?

part_A.question: Does / Lan’s brother / fairy tales? / like / reading /
part_A.answer: Does Lan’s brother like reading fairy tales?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "Does" + like + V-ing: like reading fairy tales.

part_A.question: to school / I didn’t. / Did you go / yesterday? – No, /
part_A.answer: Did you go to school yesterday? – No, I didn’t.
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi quá khứ "Did…?" + trả lời ngắn "No, I didn't."

part_A.question: is / vase / flower / This / beautiful. /
part_A.explanation: S + be + tính từ: This flower vase is beautiful.

part_A.question: is / This / my cousin. He / is from / Nam Dinh. /
part_A.answer: This is my cousin. He is from Nam Dinh.
part_A.explanation: Câu giới thiệu + "be from + nơi chốn".

part_A.question: the park. / bike in / hobby is / riding a / My /
part_A.answer: My hobby is riding a bike in the park.
part_A.explanation: "My hobby is + V-ing" = Sở thích của tôi là…

part_A.question: is / Linh’s birthday / the third / on / of June. /
part_A.answer: Linh’s birthday is on the third of June.
part_A.explanation: Sinh nhật + on + the + số thứ tự + of + tháng.

part_A.question: It was / Saturday / yesterday and / very cold. / it was /
part_A.answer: It was Saturday yesterday and it was very cold.
part_A.explanation: "It was + thứ + yesterday" – thì quá khứ với "be".

part_A.question: work in / a bank. / and my / My mother / grandfather /
part_A.answer: My mother and my grandfather work in a bank.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ ghép số nhiều + work (không thêm -s) + in a bank.

part_A.question: often / have Vietnamese / do you / in your school? / How /
part_A.answer: How often do you have Vietnamese in your school?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi tần suất: How often + do + you + have + môn học?

part_A.question: My brother / every / has English / Tuesday. / and P.E /
part_A.answer: My brother has English and P.E every Tuesday.
part_A.explanation: S + has + môn học + every + thứ.

part_A.question: books are / there on / How many / comic / your bookshelf? /
part_A.answer: How many comic books are there on your bookshelf?
part_A.explanation: Hỏi số lượng: How many + danh từ số nhiều + are there + on + nơi chốn?

part_A.question: in the / to go swimming / Does / afternoon? / Jim want /
part_A.answer: Does Jim want to go swimming in the afternoon?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "Does" + want to + V: want to go swimming.

part_A.question: Yesterday / relaxing. / and / was / fun /
part_A.explanation: "Yesterday" làm chủ ngữ + was + hai tính từ nối bằng "and".

part_A.question: you / cartoons? / like / Do / watching /
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi "Do you like + V-ing?" = Bạn có thích làm gì không?

part_A.question: breakfast / rice and / with fried / a salad. / Jane had /
part_A.answer: Jane had breakfast with fried rice and a salad.
part_A.explanation: "have breakfast with + món ăn" ở thì quá khứ: had breakfast.

part_A.question: from London? / of the girl / the name / is / What /
part_A.answer: What is the name of the girl from London?
part_A.explanation: "the name of + danh từ" = tên của ai/cái gì.

part_A.question: want / I don’t / the coffee. / in / much sugar /
part_A.answer: I don’t want much sugar in the coffee.
part_A.explanation: "much + danh từ không đếm được (sugar)" trong câu phủ định.

part_A.question: playing / likes / games. / computer / Tim /
part_A.explanation: S + like(s) + V-ing: likes playing computer games.

part_A.question: girl / is that / sitting on the bench? / tall / Who /
part_A.answer: Who is that tall girl sitting on the bench?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi "Who is + cụm danh từ + V-ing…?" để hỏi danh tính.

part_A.question: balloons / very much. / I like / and flowers /
part_A.answer: I like balloons and flowers very much.
part_A.explanation: S + like + tân ngữ nối bằng "and" + very much.

part_A.question: called / They have / Hanna. / a baby daughter /
part_A.answer: They have a baby daughter called Hanna.
part_A.explanation: "called + tên" = tên là (bổ nghĩa cho danh từ đứng trước).

part_A.question: you and your family / well. / are / I’m pleased / that /
part_A.answer: I’m pleased that you and your family are well.
part_A.explanation: "be pleased that + mệnh đề" = vui vì điều gì.

part_A.question: the post office? / show me / to / the way / Can you /
part_A.answer: Can you show me the way to the post office?
part_A.explanation: "show somebody the way to + nơi chốn" = chỉ đường cho ai.

part_A.question: and / There is / two chairs / a TV / in my room. /
part_A.answer: There is a TV and two chairs in my room.
part_A.explanation: "There is" chia theo danh từ đứng ngay sau (a TV).

part_A.question: Day. / Christmas / on / My birthday / is /
part_A.answer: My birthday is on Christmas Day.
part_A.explanation: Sinh nhật rơi vào ngày lễ: on Christmas Day.

part_A.question: is / Little Star / Primary / It / School. /
part_A.answer: It is Little Star Primary School.
part_A.explanation: "It is + tên riêng" – câu trả lời cho câu hỏi về tên trường.

part_A.question: It / is / eleven / thirty / a.m. /
part_A.explanation: Cách nói giờ: eleven thirty a.m = 11 giờ 30 phút sáng.

part_A.question: come / party. / to my / Please / birthday /
part_A.answer: Please come to my birthday party.
part_A.explanation: Câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự: Please + come to + sự kiện.

part_A.question: Tuan is / Art / having / an / lesson. /
part_A.answer: Tuan is having an Art lesson.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is having an Art lesson (đang học tiết Mĩ thuật).

part_A.question: crowded / is / but / The library / quiet. /
part_A.answer: The library is crowded but quiet.
part_A.explanation: Hai tính từ trái ngược nối bằng "but": crowded but quiet.

part_A.question: beautiful / is / and / My garden / tidy. /
part_A.answer: My garden is beautiful and tidy.
part_A.explanation: Hai tính từ cùng nghĩa tích cực nối bằng "and".

part_A.question: enjoy / lesson? / English / Do you / the /
part_A.answer: Do you enjoy the English lesson?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi "Do you enjoy + danh từ?" = Bạn có thích… không?

part_A.question: my questions. / book and / listen to / Close your /
part_A.answer: Close your book and listen to my questions.
part_A.explanation: Hai câu mệnh lệnh nối bằng "and": Close … and listen…

part_A.question: your notebooks, / please. / and / open / Sit down /
part_A.answer: Sit down and open your notebooks, please.
part_A.explanation: Hai câu mệnh lệnh + please: Sit down and open your notebooks, please.

part_A.question: an / have / We / on Monday. / English lesson /
part_A.answer: We have an English lesson on Monday.
part_A.explanation: "have + môn học + on + thứ": an English lesson on Monday.

part_A.question: sisters? / brothers or / any / have / Does Jane /
part_A.answer: Does Jane have any brothers or sisters?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "any … or …": any brothers or sisters?

part_A.question: in / work / a company? / Do / your parents /
part_A.answer: Do your parents work in a company?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "Do" + chủ ngữ số nhiều: Do your parents work…?

part_A.question: Is the / Mai? – No, / July today, / it isn’t. / second of /
part_A.answer: Is the second of July today, Mai? – No, it isn’t.
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi về ngày + trả lời phủ định ngắn "No, it isn't."

part_A.question: The television / next / the cupboard. / is / to /
part_A.answer: The television is next to the cupboard.
part_A.explanation: "next to" = bên cạnh: The television is next to the cupboard.

part_A.question: on / the stage? / beautifully / singing / Who is /
part_A.answer: Who is singing beautifully on the stage?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi "Who is + V-ing…?" và trạng từ "beautifully".

part_A.question: There / in / four seasons / our country. / are /
part_A.answer: There are four seasons in our country.
part_A.explanation: "There are + số lượng + danh từ số nhiều + in + nơi chốn."

part_A.question: building / five floors? / Does / your school / have /
part_A.answer: Does your school building have five floors?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "Does" + have + số lượng: have five floors?

part_A.question: cooking / the kitchen. / in / is / My mother /
part_A.answer: My mother is cooking in the kitchen.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is cooking in the kitchen.

part_A.explanation: "grandson, grandfather, uncle" chỉ người nam; "aunt" chỉ người nữ nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out
part_A.explanation: "Dinner, Lunch, Breakfast" là các bữa ăn; "Swim" là động từ nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out
part_A.explanation: "Sing, Dance, Draw" ở dạng nguyên thể; "Went" ở dạng quá khứ nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "green, white, yellow" là màu sắc; "when" là từ để hỏi nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "cow, buffalo, ox" là thú bốn chân; "hen" (gà mái) là loài chim nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "goldfish, rabbit, hamster" là vật nuôi; "doll" là đồ chơi nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "eight o'clock, eight a.m., eight fifteen" chỉ giờ; "eight years old" chỉ tuổi nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "Maths, Arts, Music" là môn học; "Football" là môn thể thao nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out:
part_A.explanation: "when, how, what" là từ để hỏi; "birthday" là danh từ nên khác loại.

part_A.question: Choose the odd one out
part_A.explanation: "Make, Listen, Write" ở dạng nguyên thể; "Watched" ở dạng quá khứ nên khác loại.
